My parents, who are both well-educated, encouraged me to study, but math wasn't my favorite subject in school. Now, as a part-time employee and mother, I rarely use advanced math, so my skills are a bit rusty. However, I admire its role in computer science, one of my interests.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes.
